component: Thundermail generated backup and API completion

quotes.text: await createBackup(protectedContainerKeysStr, protectedKeypairStr, passwordWrappedKeyStr, saltStr, api);

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The backup helper awaits its save request and then writes the Backup complete label without checking the returned value. The API wrapper can resolve null for a network or HTTP failure. Thus this completion path records a settled request call rather than a verified successful backup response. Folder creation also awaits that backup helper before storing and exposing a new folder, so a null save response does not enter its thrown-error rollback branch by itself.
title: Thundermail backup completion ignores the save response
